name: 79029 · Dumas, TX
findings: ZIP 79029 (Dumas) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79029 (Dumas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
